observed_failure: KeyError: 'scripts/package-delivery.py' during readiness evidence lookup after member hash verification
cause: Root source scripts are stored inside the bare Git repository, not as top-level archive members; verifier only recognized service/eval source paths.
fix: Resolve evidence present as archive members against the manifest; verify all remaining source paths against the actual recursive clone. Extract repositories in a forward-only pass after hash verification.
follow_up: Regenerate the source snapshot and delivery archive, then run the complete verifier. Actual pass/fail is recorded separately in delivery/final-verification.json.

second_attempt.observed_failure: git clone exit 128: repository does not exist despite extracted HEAD, objects and packed-refs files
second_attempt.cause: All refs were packed, so the empty refs directory was omitted by the files-only archive. Git requires that directory to recognize the bare repository.
second_attempt.fix: In each newly-created private mirror, delete and recreate each identical ref through git update-ref to materialize it as a loose reference. Verify identities unchanged and require these files at packaging. Working repositories are untouched.
